newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanwa Bank to securitise problem loans.
newsitem.headline: Sanwa Bank to securitise problem loans.

text.p: Sanwa Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to securitise problem loans using real estate collateral totalling 30 billion yen by next March.
Sanwa will securitise the problem loans based on estimates of minimum bids at court property auctions to limit investor risk, a bank spokesman said.

Banking industry sources said that some big banks are increasingly positive toward securitisation of problem loans after a government panel was set up last month to tackle the tough issue of collecting problem loans including securitisation of unrecoverable loans.
